correctness.rationale: The finite polarization family transfers scalar singular-Herglotz a.e. limits to a self-adjoint matrix boundary Y. For Im w<0, R_w=(H-wI)^-1 is analytic and bounded by 1/|Im w|; angular harmonic mean and dominated boundary passage give E[(Y-wI)^-1]=(B+iT-wI)^-1. Positive matrix spectral resolution and entrywise Cauchy inversion identify the unique measure and density D_x^{-*} T D_x^{-1}/pi; strict T>0 excludes real poles and singular mass. Noncommuting factor order is correct. At B=0 spectral calculus reduces to scalar Cauchy kernels; integration of the tails and |x|^p proves the projection I/2, formula for 0<p<1, divergence p>=1. The finite numerical matrix checker tests only 2x2 examples, not the general identity.
